review: Read all five proposed source/control bodies and the complete existing-script diff. The original launch producer receives the same session/plan once through either branch, with default None retaining the original route and timers. Only its optional resource bracket/report field and type-only cast change existing behavior.

The Linux reader holds the original directory handle, verifies actual cgroup2 mount and root ownership, bounds metadata/counter reads, refuses privileged/saved-root/capability/NoNewPrivs/thread/migration/foreign-member/child-group states, and checks its own membership around counter snapshots. It performs no cgroup writes, process reaping, product probes or retries.

Official kernel documentation confirms inherited fork membership, hierarchical cpu.stat usage/user/system counters and common-ancestor migration permission. These interfaces do not independently prove that an external controller preserved isolation.

Counter regression and admission/read failures remain unavailable. Ordinary polling still declares short-exited-descendant incompleteness. Producer returns and raised objects survive observer faults; a failed producer cannot gain a complete lifetime-tail flag.

Finite real waited-child/grandchild and failed-operation/new-session-child controls preserve the limited observation and original owner cleanup. Modeled filesystem controls validate refusal logic only; the sole real protected-kernel positive is explicitly unexecuted.

Lifetime interval totals include the worker, control and collector CPU. No observer cost is subtracted; external services, private-memory peaks, full descendant retirement and accepted CPU/request normalization are not proved.
consumer_requirements: Treat observation_complete as successful bracket/producer completion only; inspect the nested unavailable_samples/unavailable_metrics/metric_minimum_met/sample_minimum_met fields independently. It does not mean all required resources were observed.

lifetime_cpu_complete applies only to CPU charged inside the admitted group during these snapshots. Original producer return does not prove child retirement; full_resource_qualification remains false.

Before an original benchmark, freeze and review the actual external controller, unprivileged worker identity, exact source/artifacts, environment and cleanup. No cgroup migration or new child may precede admission.
Run finite real kernel positives, refused migration and lost/partial negatives on the selected host before performance selection; an unsupported/failed host remains refused.

Preserve original sample minima, alternating runs, confidence bounds, elapsed timers, outcomes and full resource requirements. Linux-first selection needs its own concrete plan; no transfer to Mac or Windows.
